about: The subject-matter topics of the reference catalogue: what each experiment or design is about, not how it is
designed or analysed (design.type says that). Each entry of a source lists one or two topic ids in topics, the
main one first. The vocabulary is kept between 20 and 40 topics. Each topic names the nearest classes of two
standards, so the catalogue can be rolled up to either one: isic, the industry view (UN ISIC Rev. 4: a section
letter, a two-digit division or a three-digit group), and ford, the research view (OECD Fields of Research and
Development, Frascati Manual 2015). An empty isic list or a null ford means that standard has no fitting class.

isic.codes: a section letter, a two-digit division or a three-digit group
